title: Mockery Manor
description: A fast, playful mystery set inside a retro theme park where understaffed chaos, class friction, and slasher energy all keep colliding.

similarReasons.wooden-overcoats: Shares the same talent for bright comic timing inside a contained ensemble mess.
similarReasons.victoriocity: A good next pick if you want another witty mystery world with strong character bounce.
similarReasons.midnight-burger: Useful if you want another funny, high-energy listen that still knows how to land emotion.

archiveTake: A sharp recommendation when you want comedy, a clean mystery engine, and a setting that does half the work for the show.

metadata.importOfficialSummary: Summer, 1989, somewhere in deepest darkest England. Mockery Manor is a theme park where people disappear, and it's up to a pair of chaotic teenage twins to catch a killer. British Podcast Awards 'Best Fiction' Nominee 2020. If you like Widow's Bay, Hot Fuzz , and Only Murders In The Building , then Mockery Manor is for you. Mockery Manor is a full-cast production best enjoyed using headphones. ]]>
